message: Enter the password for this data source to connect.

The server did not accept the user name or password. Check them in Edit Data Source.

The server did not answer within 10 seconds. Check the host and your network.

The database user is not allowed to run this statement.

This data source is read-only, so GoLens did not run the statement. Turn off Read-only in Edit Data Source to allow writes.
The connection to the server was lost. Run the statement again to reconnect.
The database reported an error while running the statement.
GoLens could not complete the request because of an internal error.
Enter a value for every parameter to run this statement.
Commit or roll back the open transaction first.
The result is too large to copy. Export it to a file instead.
A row no longer matches what GoLens read, so nothing was saved. Reload the table and make the change again.
